description: This file defines FastAPI route endpoints for managing invoices, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, exporting, and generating balance sheet reports related to invoices.

methods.name: list_invoices( customer_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer ID"), status_: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="status", description="Filter by status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of invoices, optionally filtered by customer ID and status.

methods.name: get_invoice( invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific invoice by its ID.

methods.name: create_invoice( invoice: models.InvoiceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new invoice along with its items.

methods.name: update_invoice( invoice_id: int, body: models.InvoiceBase, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates main details of an existing invoice.

methods.name: delete_invoice( invoice_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes an invoice and all associated items, payments, and reminders.

methods.name: export_invoices( export_type: str = Query("pdf", enum=["pdf", "excel"], description="Export type"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Exports invoices in PDF or Excel format.

methods.name: balance_sheet( from_date: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), to_date: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), customer_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generates a balance sheet report filtered by date and customer.
